question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 48°. AB and AC are produced to points D and E, respectively. If the bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at a point O, then ∠BOC is equal to :
solution:
Given:

∠A = 48º

Concept:

If P is the meeting point of bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE. Then, ∠P = 1over 2 (180º - ∠A)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0207f0b55ecadd99c4f9822222611f9474dd7b065ca8f461f295871b44b1b533.png] 

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0808d6c97ef43d2199c6098057f9c72baa35610efac391e08cf4b0fae1f82262.png] 

Substituting the value of A

⇒ ∠BOC = 1over 2 (180º - 48º)

⇒ ∠BOC = 1over 2 (132º) = 66º

Hence, the value of ∠BOC is 66º.
